name: Consequence land (money beat)
role: Fired at the full-tier consequence-beat land — the punctuation as a big money outcome settles onto the ledger. accent('consequence') in the ConsequenceBeat `land` phase (clock in components/run/useConsequenceLadder.ts), replacing the generic thump on the flagship (full-tier) events only.
emotionalTarget: weight, finality, resolution — the number has landed and the ledger is closed. Bureaucratic, not tragic: this is a stamp coming down, not a funeral.
engine: src/audio/AudioEngine.ts (Tone.js synth — no samples), built from STINGERS.consequence in src/audio/score.ts

leitmotif.shape: The tune's own bar-10 figure — the stepwise descent home, 5-4-b3-1, resolving to the tonic D. Quoting the theme is the point: a consequence feels like part of the score rather than an interruption of it. It is deliberately the mirror of the ascending, celebratory `mastered` (D4-F4-A4-D5) and `levelup` (F4-A4-D5-F5) arps.

harmony: Dm (settle: D3 / A3 / D4, held a HALF NOTE — '2n' = 1.111s)

loop.note: Not a loop. A single grid-quantized accent fired on `land`; each synth voice disposes itself. Quantized to the next 8th (277.778ms at 108 BPM) via the shared accent scheduler so it locks to the running Transport.

voices.impact: Tone.MembraneSynth D2 quarter-note (-3dB) — the deep tonic stamp, retuned from the old A1.
voices.paper: White NoiseSynth transient (0.14s, 160Hz highpass, -14dB) — the air a stamp displaces.
voices.descent: trianglePluck (triangle osc; envelope a .004 / d .32 / s .05 / r .45, -9dB) arpeggiating A4-G4-F4-D4 at 70ms per step.
voices.settle: trianglePluck D3/A3/D4 at '2n' (1.111s), -12dB, entering 280ms after the impact — the low, quiet close.

changedFromPrevious: Shape retained (impact -> descent -> settle), material retuned and shortened. The descent moved from E5-D5-C5-A4 (A minor) to A4-G4-F4-D4 (D minor, and now a quotation of the theme). The impact moved A1 -> D2. Critically, the settle chord was a PolySynth stack held for a FULL MEASURE ('1m'); it is now a half note ('2n'). That held chord was half the reason the outro sounded like an alarm — see STINGER_MAX_SOUNDING_SEC in src/audio/score.ts.
intensityLayers: None — a one-shot. Only fires on the full tier (|delta money| >= $1,000 or >= 10% of net worth); the minor tier stays lighter per the bookends/fatigue rule (section 1.2). It rides on top of the `gameplay` bed at whatever intensity the run is currently at; nothing about the accent changes with intensity.

cuePoints.land: accent('consequence') is requested ACCENT_PREROLL_MS (120ms) before the visual landing instant so the engine's 8th-note quantization resolves it ONTO that instant. It is layered under the tonal stampGood/stampBad and the cash sfx so gain/loss colour is preserved.
cuePoints.hitstop: An 80ms HITSTOP freeze separates the impact from its follow-through (src/motion/tokens).

transitions.in: Beat already running the `gameplay` bed; the accent sits on top, no phase change.

accessibility: Respects global mute (routed through the accent bus / master gain). Silent until a user gesture starts the engine. Under prefers-reduced-motion the beat renders its final state with no ceremony and does not fire the cue (no motion, no cue churn). Muted and not-yet-unlocked players get the identical visual ladder on a locally-anchored performance.now() grid at the same tempo.
originality: Original composition for LifePatch — a descending D-minor resolution quoting this score's own theme. No transcribed, sampled, or copied melodies, beats, riffs, drops or arrangements.
license: Original work, in-repo synth. No third-party samples or external sources.

qc.noClipping: voices sum well under 0dBFS (impact -3dB membrane, paper -14dB, descent -9dB, settle -12dB) on the accent bus which pre-masters; verify no >0dBFS when stacked with stampGood/stampBad + cash
qc.accentCannotHang: soundingSec 1.85 <= STINGER_MAX_SOUNDING_SEC (2.222s, one bar at 108 BPM); trianglePluck envelope (a .004 / d .32 / s .05 / r .45) inside STINGER_ENVELOPE_CAP (a <= .01 / d <= .35 / s <= .05 / r <= .5). The settle is the longest layer and it is a half note, not a measure.
